summary: Phase-4 (Model Answers + Free Talk) verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 7/7 passed: /api/score IELTS returns non-empty model_answer plus score_value 0-9 in IELTS Band + 2-3 grammar + 3 vocabulary + phraseology=null; ICAO returns non-empty model_answer plus 2-3 phraseology + score_value 1-6; new mode:'free' returns score_label='Fluency' + summary + <=3 grammar + <=3 vocabulary + non-empty model_answer + phraseology=null; <3-word transcript returns 400 for ielts/icao/free. Frontend (mobile 390x844, injected fake webkitSpeechRecognition + granted mic): IELTS flow tap record -> tap stop -> scoring-loading -> model-answer-card appears; model-answer-toggle reveals model-answer-text (visible: true) and collapsing removes it (count=0). Free Talk tab renders free-topic-card, free-topic-text, goal-chip-20/30 (switches target between /20:00 and /30:00), encouragement-text, next-topic-button (changes topic text). Recording 3s then stop advanced free-today-time from '0:00' to '0:03', localStorage key free_talk_v1 stored {byDate:{today:3}}, and time persisted after full page reload. get-tips-button appeared after stop; tapping it showed tips-loading then free-summary + FeedbackCards + a 'Say it more fluently' model-answer-card whose toggle also reveals its text. All 4 tabs (IELTS, ICAO, Free Talk, History) navigate without red screens. Only remaining warnings are the pre-existing react-native-web deprecation warnings on RecordButton (shadow* props, props.pointerEvents) already reported in iteration_1/2 and unrelated to this phase.

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing react-native-web deprecation: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow). Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/RecordButton.tsx
Pre-existing react-native-web deprecation: props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/RecordButton.tsx

action_items: None blocking. Optional (already flagged in prior iterations): migrate RecordButton shadow* props to boxShadow and move pointerEvents='none' into style to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: build_system_message now emits model_answer for all three modes; Assessment.model_answer defaults to "" and is populated from parsed JSON via _strip_json — safe against markdown-fenced LLM output. phraseology remains None for ielts/free and a list for icao.

ModelAnswerCard.tsx: correct testIDs (model-answer-card, model-answer-toggle, model-answer-text); collapsed state omits model-answer-text from tree — matches the spec of tap-to-reveal / tap-to-collapse.

free.tsx: onMicPress -> rec.start(), and rec.isRecording true->false transition flushes sessionSeconds to storage via addSeconds -> localStorage free_talk_v1; goal chips update dailyGoalMin immediately. getTips guards <3-word transcript with tipState='error' before calling backend, matching backend 400 rule.
freetalk.ts: streak increments only if lastGoalDate === yesterday, otherwise resets to 1 — correct daily-streak logic; byDate is per-YYYY-MM-DD.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Model-answer reveal/collapse on IELTS + all Free Talk acceptance flows + tab nav)

seed_data_creation: None. Free Talk localStorage was written organically by a 3-second recorded session during the test.

Free Talk persistence key is localStorage 'free_talk_v1'. History persistence key is 'practice_history_v1'. No new bugs found in this phase.
